headline: Revenue +9% (+10% cc) on Asia surge and 6% North America comps; FY27 outlook raised but Q3 guide of 3-4% disappointed.
guidance_note: FY27 cc revenue growth raised to ~6-7% (from 5-6%); Q3 cc revenue guided +3-4%, below ~4.2% expected; AUR growth to slow to mid-single digits.
key_messages: North America revenue +6% to $885M; NA retail comps +6% (stores +6%, digital +5%); NA wholesale +8% incl. ~4 pts shipment timing pull-forward.
Asia revenue +28% to $571M; China up more than 35% reported and in constant currency.
Europe revenue +1% reported to $696M with comps -1%; coverage cites inflation-weary European shoppers pulling back.
AUR up ~9%; adjusted gross margin 70.5% (+250 bps) on AUR, mix and lower product costs; reported 74.2% lifted by tariff refunds.
Inventory down 9% YoY to $1.2B; ~$250M buyback completed FY27 repurchase plan.

consumer.big_ticket: Full-price demand held in North America (comps +6%) while Europe softened; Q3 guide implies deceleration.
consumer.pricing: AUR +9% from full-price selling; reported margin boosted by tariff refunds received in the quarter, excluded from adjusted results.
consumer.quote: We've got good momentum in North America. (CEO Patrice Louvet, interview)

macro_read: US aspirational-to-affluent apparel demand stayed healthy at full price, but growth is slowing into holiday and Europe is weakening; tariff refunds flattered reported profit.
notes: Growth is as reported; a constant-currency North America figure was not found. North America retail comps are in the key messages.
Released 2026-11-05 (today); same-day closing move not confirmed - reports range from about -4% to -8% intraday, so no stock move is shown.
EPS consensus null: sources cite $4.17, $4.23 (implied), $4.25 and $4.26.
Reported diluted EPS $4.87 includes tariff refunds; adjusted $4.64 excludes them and restructuring/other charges.
The gross-margin change shown is the adjusted change; reported gross margin was +620 bps.
The digital figure is the North America digital comp, not total company digital growth.
